## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] One logical change per commit
- [ ] A test covers the change (it fails without it)
- [ ] Docs are updated if a flag or behaviour changed, and CHANGELOG has a line if users will notice
- [ ] A claim about how an agent behaves links to its official docs in `src/profiles.ts`, with the checked date
- [ ] Token counts stay labelled as estimates, and there are no network calls
- [ ] No temporary or local-only files (those go in `.local/`)
